task.title: Check a deployment rollout
task.shortdesc: Wait up to two minutes for deployment progress.

prereq.p: Confirm the cluster context with the release owner. The sample requires the nginx deployment in the default namespace and permission to get and watch deployments.

context.p: This task reads status. It does not change the deployment.

info.p: Stop if the context differs from the release record.

stepresult.p: On success, kubectl reports that the deployment successfully rolled out.

result.p: Record the context, namespace, command, output, and time. A timeout requires investigation and does not reverse changes.

postreq.p: Run the approved application smoke test after a successful rollout. Escalate a failure to the release owner.
